_note: DEMO DATA - fictional business. Pricing uses Malaysian market estimates (see pricing._note), not a real company's rate card.
policies: Quotations are prepared by the company after information is collected and reviewed.
Specialist work (mould, asbestos, lead paint, structural damage) requires an inspection.

pricing._note: Malaysian market ESTIMATES in MYR for the demo, checked against public listings in 2025-26; replace with the SME's real rate card. Labour-only painter rate roughly RM0.35-0.45 per sq ft per coat (1 m2 = 10.76 sq ft). Economy ~ Dulux Pentalite class (5L ~ RM164), standard ~ Nippon interior emulsion (5L ~ RM235), premium ~ washable/anti-mould range (price estimated, not sourced). Prep rate ~ RM176 per 8-hour painter day. Prices exclude any applicable tax. Cross-check (Oct 2026, public Malaysian sources): interior wall/ceiling painting from about RM2.20 psf, premium whites about RM2.50 psf (recommend.my); supply-and-apply RM1.80-6.80 psf per coat (Qanvast); a 1,000 sq ft 3-bed apartment about RM3,500 for basic painting. This card works out to roughly RM2.2-2.5 per sq ft of painted surface. All figures are estimates: the SME replaces them with their real rate card, and the final price is confirmed on site.
pricing._benchmark_note: Rates come from giser_painting_prices_malaysia_2026.xlsx (real Klang Valley data). Walls: SRC001 My Reno Service study, 10 contractor quotes, 1,205 sq ft, minor filling/sanding, two coats Nippon Vinilex 5000: paint+labour RM1.30/sq ft + preparation RM0.65/sq ft = RM1.95 median (range RM1.70 to RM2.30). Ceiling: SRC003 listing RM1.20/sq ft, scope not stated (medium-low confidence). Values marked 'assumption' are not in the sheet.

benchmark.preparation_note: good: no filling needed; minor: the SRC001 scope; moderate: twice the minor rate (assumption, not in the sheet)
benchmark.tier_note: assumption: SRC001 used Nippon Vinilex 5000 (standard); economy/premium adjustments are not in the sheet, owner can change them

pricing.markup_note: 0 because the benchmark rates are what customers pay contractors (all-in quotes); the owner can add a margin here
